title: New Dance Red White Blue
author: Don Flaherty
problems: The progression after row 3 "slice left and straight back with neighbors and come back straight" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 4 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 5 "balance the ring" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 2 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 3 "slice left and straight back with neighbors and come back straight" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 (couple 1) must stand on a side line facing across.
Row 9 "right diagonal right left through to newneighbors" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the right diagonal.
choices: Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
Give & take: half the beats to cross, half to back home holding both hands.
